title: ipfs mcp agent settings: test-connection shapes
description: Request and result of the test-connection endpoint (mcp-agent-settings-api 1.4). The check probes a candidate URL only: https, or http on loopback; credentials in the URL are rejected; the server applies a bounded timeout and persists nothing. Authentication, when needed, uses the currently stored key, never a key sent with this request.

base_url.description: Candidate endpoint URL. https for any host; http only for loopback (localhost, 127.0.0.1, [::1]). No userinfo: a URL carrying credentials does not validate.

kind.description: Backend kind to probe as. Absent means openai.

ok.description: Whether the candidate URL answered as the chosen backend kind within the bounded timeout.

detail.description: Why the check failed when ok is false. Never includes credentials or key material.
